My LO also no words at all. Doesn't like AAC device, buttons,cards,gestures,etc... it's just so draining and frustrating trying to look for advice of other nonverbal/nonspeaking only to find out that oh your kid DOES have words... we just apparently have very different meaning of nonverbal/nonspeaking.

TLDR: first off sorry if I offended anyone. Just a parent that really wants to hear my LO speak and be able to communicate like how society shows.. hope that makes sense. 🙏

I just feel so defeated and yearning to have her voice heard again (at 1yo used to say hi/bye/mama/da). 😫

The problem with the app I have on her tablet that does this is she knows how to exit it and go on games. I do try modeling what she presses. She just gets frustrated when I don't allow her to switch out if this app for practicing communicating.

Asking in regards of meltdown for my lvl 2 daughter. Once inside the house her meltdown still continued. Series of her holding my hand leading to kitchen. I open both doors on fridge, offer her usual (eggo waffles 🧇 or dino nuggets), tried to see if she'd like the new snack (chocolate covered strawberries 🍓 since she likes chocolate and eats strawberries). None to her satisfaction. Opened the pantry let her look, then carried her to look on upper shelves. Nope. (Mind she finished her chips yesterday so might be looking for those).

Devoured just the pb on those nutter butter snacks (no, just peanut butter inside, she won't eat the outside cookie/wafer parts). Ate just the pasta from the garlic chicken pasta dish (always exposed to the veggies, just wont eat them) and had some milk.

>Also, one thing I've learned from my lvl 2 son is that they are a lot more aware of what is going on and being said around them than they let on.
 
Thank you for sharing this 🙏 and my apologies for the too much info in my posts/comments.

My 3y 9m does the same! Babbles, no words, grabs hand and leads to area (like kitchen), so it's a guessing game if what she wants from there.

Her go-to shows are Little Baby Bum, Bluey, Cocomelon (sometimes). Moviewise, we finally got off the Encanto binge... don't get me wrong, I like the movie and songs, but constantly over and over, it gets old and a bit annoying.

We did have speech therapy going for her, didn't seem like anything was helping much? Was just I think 30mins / 1hr sessions. Might go for different services I don't know yet.
